name: Beringer Daevaris
source:
This child is a peasant boy saved by Nerifiel from a slave shipement. Shortly after his rescue, he experienced a late Awakening to magic to become a Rozenkreuz.

The kid is easily spooked, shy, and impossibly easy to coax with hot rolls and milk.
